title: Inoculation Prompting Generalization: Does Seeing One Misaligned Domain Protect Against Others?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Directly tests whether inoculation is a scalable safety measure. If it generalizes, a small diverse set provides broad protection. If not, this informs the scalability challenge. Clear safety implications either way.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires training with inoculation data from one domain, then fine-tuning on another deceptive domain, then evaluating. Multiple fine-tuning stages and dataset construction for different deceptive domains is complex for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Multiple fine-tuning phases (inoculation training + deceptive fine-tuning + evaluation) across domains. Even scoped to 2 domains, this is multi-step and dataset-creation-heavy for 30 hours.
